modules.title: Changing data and making it fast

skills.title: Tables, rows, and keys
skills.description: See a database as tables of rows, identify rows with primary keys, and point across tables with foreign keys.

skills.title: Select, from, where
skills.description: Pick columns with SELECT, name the table with FROM, and keep matching rows with WHERE.

skills.title: Filtering, nulls, and sorting
skills.description: Combine conditions, test for null with IS NULL, and order and limit results.

skills.title: Aggregates and grouping
skills.description: Collapse rows with COUNT, SUM, and AVG, define groups with GROUP BY, and filter groups with HAVING.

skills.title: Inner joins
skills.description: Pair rows across tables on a foreign key, and keep only the matches.

skills.title: Grain and fan-out
skills.description: Know what one result row represents, spot row multiplication after a join, and count entities correctly.

skills.title: Subqueries and CTEs
skills.description: Name each step of a query with a CTE, check its grain, and build the answer step by step.

skills.title: Insert, update, delete safely
skills.description: Change rows with a WHERE clause, and make mistakes undoable with transactions.

skills.title: Indexes and query plans
skills.description: Create an index for a query shape, read EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN, and weigh read speed against write cost.

skills.title: Schema design basics
skills.description: Split a flat export into tables, place foreign keys on the many side, and add constraints that refuse bad rows.
